name: Pusher Channels JavaScript Client
solves: Provides a client-side SDK for Pusher Channels, a hosted WebSocket-based pub/sub service, with automatic reconnection, fallback transports (XHR streaming, polling, SockJS), and support for public, private, presence, and encrypted channels.
best_for: Adding real-time notifications, chat, or live updates to web apps using a fully managed WebSocket service
Multi-framework projects (React, Angular, Vue, Node.js) that need a single consistent realtime client
Apps requiring presence channels to track which users are online in a room or collaboration feature
Projects that need encrypted end-to-end channels for sensitive real-time data
Rapidly prototyping real-time features without managing WebSocket infrastructure
skip_when: You need a self-hosted or open-source realtime server to avoid vendor lock-in to Pusher's hosted service
Your use case requires heavy bidirectional client-to-client messaging beyond Pusher's client event limitations
You need CRDT-based document collaboration or conflict resolution (use Yjs or Liveblocks instead)
Your project's budget cannot accommodate Pusher's per-connection/message pricing at scale
You only need simple server-to-server WebSocket connections without pub/sub channel semantics
